name: Robot-assisted surgery with an autonomous assist
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for a surgical robot with an autonomous suturing assist, working under a surgeon at the console. Illustrative draft values, not clinical limits.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for one robot-assisted procedure in which an autonomous assist moves instruments while a surgeon supervises from the console.
scope.boundary: One surgical robot, its instruments, its navigation and imaging, the autonomous assist, and the surgeon's console.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced
Any claim of regulatory compliance or certification

scored_signals.reason: Distance from the instrument tip to the nearest registered critical structure, such as a major vessel or nerve. It moves with the patient's breathing.
Force at the instrument tip. Excess force tears tissue.
Gap between the commanded and measured tip position. A gap means the instrument is not where the system believes it is.
Error between the preoperative images and the patient on the table. Navigation is only as good as this match.
Delay of the endoscope video at the console. A surgeon who sees late cannot supervise in time.
Confidence of the autonomous assist in its next motion. Unfamiliar anatomy lowers it.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable operating range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range, missing evidence, or a hard rule met

required_standing.source_requirement: For clinical, regulatory or insurance use, the evaluation source should be independent of the device manufacturer.

notes: Threshold values are illustrative draft values for a demonstration and are not clinical limits.
The distance to a critical structure moves with respiration. A margin set on a still phantom is too small on a breathing patient.

For orientation only, not a compliance claim. Standards that address this class of device include IEC 80601-2-77 for robotically assisted surgical equipment, ISO 14971 for risk management and IEC 62304 for medical device software.
